text: On October 1 and 4, 2021, City Council authorized the initiation of expropriation proceedings for permanent and temporary easements required from the owners of the properties known municipally as 19, 21, 23, 25 and 27 Halford Avenue (the "Property Requirements"). The acquisition of these easements is essential to Transportation Services' project to (i) the removal of the current retaining wall, (ii) the construction and of a new retaining wall, and (iii) all works ancillary thereto (the "Project"). This report relates to the second stage of the expropriation process. During the first stage and in accordance with the Expropriations Act (the "Act"), Notices of Application for Approval to Expropriate were served on all applicable "registered owners", who had 30 days to request an inquiry into whether the proposed taking is fair, sound, and reasonably necessary.
